body:
Repair successor published at `a97ec757ba2bc84292729ee8675d0f5459d3808a` / tree `1742c3f7ceb9c5556571dbc28a82f90af9664283` on `codex/7794-sibling-effect-credit` (ordinary fast-forward from a4). PR remains open and Draft; the existing PR body is unchanged.

Both findings in [independent review 5514746741](https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm/pull/7817#pullrequestreview-5514746741) are repaired:
- P1: `Some(false)` retains independently confirmed tokens through their existing field/collection identity gates while refusing kind-only credit. The compiled public analyzer regression and reveal regression failed at the intended weak-versus-yes assertion before production repair.
- P2: indexed source bytes are shared instead of copied per probe; receiver-independent expansion facts are lazily cached per immutable classification run. The 64-file/768-query regression observes 64 scans. Workspace macro/attribute/parse/Drop unknowns remain conservative, including renamed Drop import paths; no general alias support was added.

Exact published-head Linux/Rust 1.95.0 evidence: public analyzer suite 14/14, reveal 114/114, expansion 2/2, transitive 66/66, path roots 5/5, retained CLI rerun 17/17; goldens, honesty, dogfood, check-fast and precommit each exit 0. Check-fast's stable 55-path/15-gate selector was independently reconciled. No golden was blessed. The restored environment required a locked fetch of fixture-pinned anyhow 1.0.100; the unchanged-source golden retry passed. Precommit survived the reported environment disconnection and returned explicit exit 0; it was not restarted.

The final head is also the executed current-main composition: main `a84449ad6cbbe026f838cab656ad82993ccdc5e3` was incorporated through merge `704c4f611...` (parents previous repair `008fc842...`, main a844), then a97 removed a duplicated neutral callback in the unit test while retaining its explicit `Some(false)`. Main's sibling-exclusion admission and the implicit-effect admission remain separate. Earlier main-1cdc composition results and intermediate failures retain their original identities.

Fresh independent Luna source/merge-seam review on a97 found no remaining source finding. The reviewer independently reconciled author-executed receipts and selector; it did not run Cargo. [Review and raw evidence](https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm/tree/b1b12c39ac2e7fbd6b2a8a78e4c31cbb4f2e85f9/evidence/7817-token-cache), [evidence README](https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm/blob/b1b12c39ac2e7fbd6b2a8a78e4c31cbb4f2e85f9/evidence/7817-token-cache/README.md), [SHA-256 manifest](https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm/blob/b1b12c39ac2e7fbd6b2a8a78e4c31cbb4f2e85f9/evidence/7817-token-cache/SHA256SUMS): 194 verified payloads. Separate loop/operator fixture runtime originals pass 2/2 each; compiling `set(1)`→`set(0)` net-effect controls fail only the actual sink observer (exit 101). These fixture controls are not analyzer mutations. Prior evidence at 5585bfb6 remains unchanged.

Disposition: `CANDIDATE_REPAIRED / REVIEW_INCOMPLETE` for hosted qualification. The first-page PR-run snapshot shows CI, ub-review, Windows advisory, wheel qualification and Source of Truth still in progress, with Droid review pending; no hosted merge qualification is claimed. The inherited full external-corpus setup failure remains separate under #7880. No review-thread resolution, Ready, protected PR merge, release, gate or credential/security changes were performed. Parent retains hosted qualification and lifecycle decisions.
